notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two mana-producing lands.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Marvin using Ley Weaver's ability by tapping it, untapping two lands.
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
